title: Sluggish Moisture Journey: A Snail Mucin Misadventure
date: Reviewed in the United States on 17 January 2024
review: Ah, the elusive Snail Mucin face moisturizer, a product that promised to leave my skin feeling refreshed, rejuvenated, and perhaps even a little slimy. Alas, my experience with this peculiar concoction left much to be desired. Brace yourselves, dear readers, for a tale of moisturizing misfortune!Now, let's start with the texture. Imagine slapping a snail on your face and hoping for the best. Well, that's pretty much what it felt like. The consistency was, shall we say, slimetastic? As I attempted to spread this gooey elixir, I couldn't help but wonder if I had entered a new realm of skincare where snails were the key to eternal beauty. Spoiler alert: they're not.As I waited for the promised hydration to seep into my skin, I couldn't help but notice the rather peculiar scent. It was like stepping into a garden after a heavy rain shower, only to discover that the rain was actually snail drool. It wasn't exactly the fragrance I was hoping for, and I couldn't help but wonder if I had mistakenly stumbled upon a snail's secret spa.Now, the real fun began when I tried to apply makeup over this slimy substance. It was like trying to paint a masterpiece on a canvas that was covered in... you guessed it, snail mucus. My foundation clung to every crevice, creating a patchy and uneven finish that left me resembling a modern art experiment gone wrong. Let's just say, I wasn't ready to debut my avant-garde snail-inspired makeup look to the world just yet.To top it all off, the moisturizing effects were lackluster at best. Despite the snail mucin's claims of providing hydration and nourishment, my skin remained as thirsty as a desert cactus. It seemed that the snail's secretions were more interested in leaving a gooey residue on my face than actually moisturizing my skin. Disappointing, indeed.In conclusion, my journey with the Snail Mucin face moisturizer was akin to a snail's slow crawl through molasses – sluggish, slimy, and ultimately unsatisfying. While the concept might have seemed intriguing, the reality fell flat. So, unless you're a snail enthusiast or have an unusual affinity for garden-scented skincare, I'd recommend exploring other options in the moisturizer department. Trust me, your skin will thank you!Rating: 🐌/5 (one snail for effort, but that's about it!)

title: Don't fall for it!
date: Reviewed in the United States on 16 November 2023
review: I can't believe I fell for this. Im not easily influenced by social media into buying beauty products but they got me this time. I'm so upset I fell for this. I've been struggling with hormonal cystic acne for years. My skin gets worse during the colder months due to it getting dry. I don't like putting too much stuff on my face for fear my acne will get worse. I bought both the serum and moisturizer hoping both would keep my skin hydrated and help repair it of the hyperpigmentation and scars. I did notice I change in my skin after using these products, but for the WORSE. Most of my acne is around the jawline, but after using this product I started breaking out in places I wouldn't break out before. My forhead and cheeks started getting really small bumps. I started getting big red juicy pimples on my jawline, neck, my eyebrows, forehead and lip area. At first I couldn't figure out what was causing the change in my skin. I knew something was going on because these breakouts were not my usual. My face was itchy. It took me a couple weeks to figure out that this product was the reason I was breaking out so bad. I went back to read the negative reviews this product had to see if anyone experienced similar reactions and yes most of them say the same thing. I wouldn't know if product is authentic or not, it was my first time buying but the consistency of the product seemed about right. The product was a lot cheaper here on Amazon though so maybe that should've been a red flag. I really don't understand ALL the positive reviews. I don't recommend this product. I used about 5% of the product and I don't want it to go to waste but I don't know if I'm willing to give it another try.

title: Not for everyone
date: Reviewed in the United States on 13 October 2024
review: The reviews were good and I had heard good things about other products from this brand so I figured I would try it out. I have pretty normal skin, a little hormonal acne on occasion but I’m not overly dry or overly oily. While I did like the texture, this was almost the worst thing I’ve ever put on my face. I first tried it on a Friday night after washing my face after work. About an hour later I felt so dry but figured I didn’t use enough. Another review on here said that a little goes a long way so I figured that was the issue. Two hours after that my skin felt SO dry. It was as if I hadn’t put anything on after washing my face so I applied it a THIRD time in one night. Decided that I would give it a chance and went to bed. I wish I was making this up, I woke up at 2:00am because my skin was so parched. So here I go applying yet another layer. This goes on every 1.5-2 hours. It’s like this “moisturizer” is evaporating?? I really wanted to like this but decided for how often I had to apply it only for it to basically disappear an hour later, I would be using a single jar in a 12 hour period. Definitely returned and will be going back to my tried and true Aveeno. It’s fun to try the trendy products until you realize you’re dumping buckets of money on products that aren’t worth it. This was more of a reminder for me to stick to what actually works and don’t rely on the fad trends.

title: Be careful!
date: Reviewed in the United States on 25 November 2023
review: My skin is dry but NOT sensitive. I take good care of my skin and I make sure I stay hydrated. I was intrigued by that added glow and plumping factor of this popular cream and all the incredible reviews, so I thought I'd give it a try.I applied my serum, then the COS RX moisturizer. I dabbed a small amount on the palms of my hands, rubbed them together and gently applied on my face. It didn't feel slimy. As soon as it dried, my entire face felt drier and tighter. I misted my face with facial water and then I applied my moisturizer and a few facial oil drops on top (basically my normal skincare routine with the same products I use).Within seconds, I felt a little itchiness on my forehead. About a minute or so later, the itchiness on my forehead became much worse and my cheeks also felt itchy. When I looked in the mirror again my skin was very flush, raw/angry looking with tiny bumps. I knew I was having some sort of allergic reaction (I don't use any AHA/retinoids which I read can cause a reaction w/ this product, etc.) I immediately washed my face and followed with an ice roller to calm it down. The redness subsided about an hour or so later.I've never had a reaction to any skin products before. I threw this out. It was on sale, so it wasn't an expensive product. I didn't think to do a patch test, but please do. Going forward, I'm going to stick with my tried and true skin care products that have helped me maintain my skin really well through the years and I won't  be swayed by the latest fad or "wonder" product. lesson learned! All the best to you!

title: Hier leiden und sterben Schnecken für eine Creme!
review: Wissen sollte man über dieses Produkt, dass die Tiere leiden und sterben!🐌 Wie wird der Schleim gewonnen – und mit welchem Preis für die Tiere?Schneckenschleim für Kosmetik wird auf Farmen, also in Massentierhaltung, hergestellt. Die Schnecken leben größtenteils in kleinen Käfigen und werden vorsätzlich starkem Stress ausgesetzt. Dies hat einen Grund, denn Stress ist eine Voraussetzung dafür, dass die Tiere Schleim produzieren. Dafür werden die Schnecken beispielsweise zentrifugiert, also geschleudert, damit sich der Schleim nach außen absetzt. Außerdem werden die Tiere in Chemikalien getaucht, mit Salz bestreut oder mit Säure beträufelt, um sie zu verbrennen. Je mehr Stress die Schnecken empfinden, desto mehr ihres Schutzfilms produzieren sie.👉 Auf zertifizierte vegane & tierversuchsfreie Kosmetikmarken umsteigen. Viele Marken bieten hochwertige Alternativen ganz ohne tierische Bestandteile.

title: This moisturizer did nothing for me.

review: I have dry/combination skin and I bought this moisturizer to see if it was an alternative to my holy grail moisturizer, the Etude Moistfull Collagen Cream, because this cosrx moisturizer is cheaper per ounce. After testing out this moisturizer for several weeks, I found that it has the same effect on my skin as plain old water. I put it on after I wash my face, I let it soak in for a a few minutes, and then my skin is as dry as it would be had I put nothing on it.In my opinion, this moisturizer has the same feeling as a toner and it cannot be used alone. All it does is add a little temporary moisture to your skin. I've been using it underneath a cream moisturizer just to use it up because it won't stay sealed into the skin without it. This was supposed to be an affordable purchase but because I can't use it alone and must use it with another product, it is quite expensive and useless.I recommend not buying this moisturizer and trying the Etude moisturizer instead since it has both the benefits of a gel and cream moisturizer. However, I use prescription grade acne creams in the morning (sulfacetamide sodium solution) and night (tretinoin) which dry out my skin a lot. I was already using the CosRX snail mucin serum, eye cream, and centella toner and had no problems with them so I thought this would be a good purchase to have a full set of their products. I was very wrong.I've used this in the morning and at night after doing my regular skincare routine and this is just not moisturizing! It not greasy, seems pretty light weight, and just feels like a mattifying primer which those tend to leave the skin feeling very dry. So if you want a very light moisturizer that will mattify your face then this is for you.So upset that I will have to throw this out. I will be sticking to Vanicream face moisturizer which is cheaper with more product and has a pump which is more hygienic. Only reason I tried switching was because it can be too heavy and make my face look too dewy. Worth it to look extra dewy but know my face won't burn and feel dry afterwards.

One time I used it it felt like it almost burned but it went away. I tried using it on my body to not waste it but also felt the burn. I diluted it with another cream for my body and it seemed fine then.. but overall I don't see the benefit, or wasn't able to because of all the other problems. I use tret 0.5% x 2-3 week, BHA/AHA 2x week, and niacinamide in between. HA and vitC in the mornings. My skin is in a really good place despite all the actives (took a while to get here) and was just looking for a good day time moisturizer. Sticking with my cetaphil in the AM and roto of ponds/FAB/oil at night. Happy for all of you who had a good experience! If you're using tret, I don't think this will benefit you due to the sensitized skin/fragile skin barrier.

title: Schwer abbaubare Polymer in Zutaten
review: Erfahrungsbericht & Warnung: Umweltproblematische Silikone in KosmetikDieses Produkt enthält Silikone wie Dimethicone, die schwer abbaubare Polymere sind und die Umwelt belasten.Silikone werden in vielen Kosmetikprodukten verwendet, um die Haut oder Haare weich und geschmeidig erscheinen zu lassen. Doch was viele nicht wissen: Diese synthetischen Stoffe können sich in der Umwelt anreichern und sind biologisch kaum abbaubar. Das bedeutet, dass sie langfristig Ökosysteme belasten.Besonders enttäuschend finde ich, dass Cosrx sich als umweltfreundlich präsentiert, aber trotzdem solche Inhaltsstoffe verwendet. Ich werde dieses Produkt nicht wieder kaufen und rate jedem, der Wert auf Nachhaltigkeit legt, sich nach Alternativen ohne Silikone umzusehen.Fazit: Wer eine wirklich umweltfreundliche Pflege sucht, sollte die Inhaltsstoffe genau prüfen. Es gibt inzwischen viele hochwertige Alternativen mit natürlichen Inhaltsstoffen, die ohne problematische Polymere auskommen.

He told me so many of his patients come in with allergic reactions  to this product. I personally got contact dermatitis from using this one time And had To be prescribed medicated cream to help. And it should clear up in a few weeks. My suggestion is definitely do a patch test on a very small part of your face That isn’t that Noticeable I wish I would have done that to avoid all of this pain and anxiety and discomfort. Also keep in mind I get contact dermatitis from all adhesives and latex. But never a lotion or product like this so I was very surprised.
